title: ROT13 Cipher
description:
Apply the ROT13 cipher to the string `"Hello World"`. ROT13 shifts each letter by 13 positions in the alphabet (wrapping around). Non-letter characters remain unchanged. Preserve case.

**Expected output:**
```
Uryyb Jbeyq
```
starterCode:
# Write your code here
text = "Hello World"
hint: For each letter, use ord() to get its ASCII value, shift by 13 within the alphabet, and use chr() to convert back. Handle uppercase and lowercase separately.
